newsitem.title: UK: Brit Gas gains on take-or-pay deal hopes.
newsitem.headline: Brit Gas gains on take-or-pay deal hopes.

text.p: Shares in British Gas Plc were helped higher on Monday as a newspaper report said the firm was reaching final stages of negotiations on two large deals to reduce its exposure to take-or-pay deals, analysts said.
The report, published in The Times newspaper, said British Gas was believed to be in talks with oil giants Shell and British Petroleum to curb its 40 billlion stg of take-or-pay contracts.
"It's obviously positive," said Mathew Warburton, analyst at SBC Warburg in London. British Gas shares hit a day's high at 205 pence but slipped back to trade one pence up at 204 pence.
"There was lots of stuff about take-or-pay with the results last Thursday in terms of potential progress in two or three small deals," said Warburton.
"But the key news this week will be to wait and see if there is any announcement about the MMC."

British Gas has until October 7 to decide whether it will refer Ofgas's pricing proposals -- aimed at liberalising the market in storage, connection and metering -- to the monopolies and mergers commission.
But analysts said the decision may come as early as this week.
